name: Enter Furry World
source:
After a heavy storm and rough crash, you wake up on a beach. As you awaken, you see that you entered into a furry world! No more humans around, you are the only one that walks in the streets. With the help of your new found friends, will you be able to return back home? Or will you be stuck here forever?

The story will be turning around the relationship with the different characters you'll encounter throughout the game. Will you become friend with them, or become their ennemies? Will you grow a strong amourship or stay only friends? Learn more about their past and discover with their help how and why you entered a furry world!

[From [url=https://ritchlombaroo.itch.io/my-first-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一场猛烈的风暴和剧烈的碰撞后，你在海滩上醒来。当你醒来时，你发现你进入了一个毛茸茸的世界！周围不再有人类，你是唯一走在街上的人。在新朋友的帮助下，你能回家吗？还是你会永远被困在这里？

故事将围绕你在游戏中遇到的不同角色的关系展开。你会与他们成为朋友，还是成为他们的敌人？你们会发展深厚的恋情还是只做朋友？了解更多关于他们的过去，并在他们的帮助下发现你如何以及为何进入毛茸茸的世界！

[来自[url=https://ritchlombaroo.itch.io/my-first-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
